title: RMA — Monthly Report To OAIP
content: The four mapped agreements require a monthly report to OAIP. The agreement sets its contents. Dentacor reports dental pilot demographics, efficacy and incidents. Doctronic and Legion include prescription-renewal and clinical-review metrics. ElizaChat reports on its app demonstration.
